rules.description: Hyper Key - System Navigation and Controls

manipulators.description: Hyper + N: Move to space left

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Hyper + N: Move to space left' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Hyper + M: Move to space right

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Hyper + M: Move to space right' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Hyper + F: Open default application launcher

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Hyper + F: Open default application launcher' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Hyper + E: Open email client (eM Client)

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Hyper + E: Open email client (eM Client)' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Hyper + u in Obsidian/Zen move one tab left

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Hyper + u in Obsidian/Zen move one tab left' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Hyper + i in Obsidian/Zen move one tab right

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Hyper + i in Obsidian/Zen move one tab right' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Cmd + Shift + P in Zen select and paste top Proton Pass result

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Cmd + Shift + P in Zen select and paste top Proton Pass result' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Beeper: Hyper + U move up conversation (Cmd+Option+Up)

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Beeper: Hyper + U move up conversation (Cmd+Option+Up)' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Beeper: Hyper + I move down conversation (Cmd+Option+Down)

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Beeper: Hyper + I move down conversation (Cmd+Option+Down)' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Signal: Hyper + U move up conversation (Option+Up)

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Signal: Hyper + U move up conversation (Option+Up)' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Signal: Hyper + I move down conversation (Option+Down)

to_after_key_up.shell_command: echo $(date):: 'Signal: Hyper + I move down conversation (Option+Down)' >> $HOME/.local/share/karabiner/history

manipulators.description: Signal: Cmd + E archives current chat and moves to next
